messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Moved to Code.google
parts:
Hello All,

I've moved from GitHub to Google Code. The reason is now I have a bug
tracker, which GitHub apparently has but i could never find it.

The link is http://code.google.com/p/rhipe/

Now everyone can file bugs, issues, requests.

A link to installing on Amazon Elastic Mapreduce is at
http://code.google.com/p/rhipe/wiki/RHIPEonEMR


In a week, I'll be deleting the GitHub repo.

Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.author: c47f732bf0f6ef00
messages.subject: Re: Moved to Code.google
parts:
Saptarshi,

Thank you for updating the EMR script, and I found a problem. Those
two lines should be combined:

cd $PROTOBUF && ./configure && $MAKE && $SUDO $MAKE install && $SUDO
$LDCONFIG

would be

cd $PROTOBUF && ./configure && $MAKE && $SUDO $MAKE install && $SUDO
$LDCONFIG

Yours,

Masa Nakamura
